runway.noAllowance: This plan doesn't cap conversations, so there's nothing to run out of. The current period runs until {until}.

noReceipt.not_paid: No receipt — a receipt is issued when a charge is paid, and this one wasn't.
noReceipt.missing: Paid, but the receipt hasn't arrived from the payment provider.

autoPurchase.unset: Nothing is set up for running low. GOTCHA will use the default: when the credit runs out, the AI stops answering.
autoPurchase.on: Buys more automatically when credit drops to {threshold}%.
autoPurchase.warnsFirst: You're told at {warn}% — before anything is bought, so there's time to decide.
autoPurchase.noCap: No monthly limit on automatic purchases.
autoPurchase.cap: Up to {cap} {currency} a month on automatic purchases. {spent} {currency} so far this cycle — {used}.

behavior.STOP_AI: When it runs out: the AI stops answering. People can still work.
behavior.HUMAN_ONLY: When it runs out: the AI stops and your team carries on as normal.
behavior.REQUIRE_APPROVAL: When it runs out: the AI keeps working, and every action waits for someone to approve it.
behavior.PREPAID_ONLY: Never buys more. GOTCHA runs on what you bought in advance and stops when it's gone.
behavior.PAYG: When it runs out: GOTCHA keeps working and the extra usage is billed at the end of the cycle.

autoPurchase.capIsNotACap: Note: with pay-as-you-go, the monthly limit stops automatic purchases — it doesn't stop the bill. Usage past zero is still charged at the end of the cycle.
autoPurchase.unsettable: Pay-as-you-go can't be switched on or off from here — it's set up by GOTCHA for you. The other options on this page can be changed.
